summary: Remove unrenderable OpenAI citation tokens from chat delivery
description: Production replies leak private citation transport markers such as citeturn3search0turn3search1 into Telegram because the Codex final text contains symbolic source references without URL annotations. Human-facing gateways must never display renderer-internal tokens; raw/local/API surfaces retain source text for diagnostics.
acceptance: R1 Telegram and every human chat surface remove complete citation transport markers; R2 surrounding punctuation and whitespace remain natural; R3 malformed or partial markers fail safely without deleting normal prose; R4 local/API/webhook surfaces remain byte-identical; R5 real Bosch incident phrase is a regression fixture.

evidence.summary: RED: exact Bosch citation regression failed on 15 chat surfaces; GREEN: 230 focused tests passed; gateway regression suite: 320 passed; git diff --check and py_compile passed; .go validation passed
